modified_caption: This line plot illustrates the similarity of Hidden State Alignments (HSAs) across different language pairs within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model, evaluated across all layers. The horizontal axis, labeled 'Layer,' spans from 0 to 22 in increments of 2, while the vertical axis, labeled 'Similarity,' ranges from 0.00 to 0.45 in increments of 0.05. Four language pairs are depicted: English-English (en&en, red), English-Spanish (en&es, blue), English-Greek (en&el, green), and English-Bengali (en&bn, pink). The en&en pair demonstrates a pronounced peak at layer 6, reaching a similarity of approximately 0.26, before stabilizing around 0.15 from layers 8 to 18 and sharply rising to 0.43 at layer 22. The en&es pair follows a similar trajectory, peaking at 0.24 at layer 6, but subsequently declines more gradually, maintaining a similarity of roughly 0.12 between layers 10 and 16, and ultimately rising to 0.27 at layer 22. The en&el pair exhibits a modest peak of 0.15 at layer 6, then collapses to near-baseline levels by layer 10, remaining stagnant until a late resurgence to 0.18 at layer 22. The en&bn pair, while initially the lowest, consistently surpasses the en&el pair after layer 8, achieving a final similarity of 0.30 at layer 22. Notably, the en&es pair consistently exceeds the en&el pair in similarity across all intermediate layers, underscoring a robust cross-linguistic alignment for high-resource languages.

modifications.claim: The en&el pair collapses to near-baseline levels by layer 10 and remains stagnant until a late resurgence to 0.18 at layer 22.
modifications.reality: The en&el pair actually declines to approximately 0.05 by layer 10 but does not remain stagnant; it fluctuates slightly and rises to 0.30 at layer 22, not 0.18.

modifications.claim: The en&bn pair consistently surpasses the en&el pair after layer 8.
modifications.reality: The en&bn pair does not consistently surpass the en&el pair after layer 8; they are closely matched, with the en&el pair occasionally exceeding the en&bn pair (e.g., around layer 12).

modifications.claim: The en&es pair maintains a similarity of roughly 0.12 between layers 10 and 16.
modifications.reality: The en&es pair maintains a similarity closer to 0.15-0.17 between layers 10 and 16, not 0.12.
